prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
Three stacked coins viewed from the edge — three narrow horizontal
ellipses in flat saturated fill, the topmost coin in a warmer gold-

formatted_prompt: Flat app icon centered on off-white (#E7E3D5) canvas with generous padding, modern UI register, crisp vector geometry. Three stacked coins viewed from the edge — three bold horizontal ellipses layered in a tight vertical stack, rendered as flat filled shapes with sharp clean edges. The bottom two coins in warm terracotta-amber (#D97742), the topmost coin in pale gold-ochre (#C9A96B) for clear differentiation. Each coin ellipse has a slim flat rectangular side face in deep burnt sienna, giving readable edge-on depth. No gradients, no brushwork, no texture. Adult proportions, bold silhouette legible at 16px, every edge precise and deliberate.
